# Localify camera source snapshot — integration in progress

These files are a source snapshot from the locally modified GakuLocalify hosted
tree at `source/GakuLocalify-hosted` (Git base `cd5db7bda8009bdd52aed43309c7b827f681fbb3`,
including local changes). The camera implementation and the input fence retain
the original project's GPL-3.0 license; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

These files retain their original include paths and do not participate in the
build. The integrated implementation and its hook/lifecycle changes live in
`camera-core/`; see that directory for its status and license.
